description: This file is a PHP plugin for the Smarty templating engine, defining a function named 'sugar_getjspath' that adds a JavaScript cache-busting string to a file path.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_getjspath
methods.description: Defines a Smarty plugin function that appends a cache-busting query string to a JavaScript file path, triggering an error if the 'file' parameter is missing.
